messages:
Sam Parker: Quick shift check-in. Deployed rate-limiter tweak ~2m ago. Noticing a small spike in embeddings queue depth and p99 on the embed route. Mitigation applied (temporary bypass). Will summarize: incident state, mitigations, and next steps below.

Ops-Bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy success — service: prod-rate-limiter, rev: ab12cd34, started_by: sam.parker, finished at 1798509900

Irene Cho: I can see the 5xx/error spike on /v1/embeddings and queue length up ~3x since deploy. Added temporary routing rule to send embeds to fallback-embed-pool to avoid rate-limiter hot-path. Rule: `routing.policy = "fallback-embed-pool"`

Mike Chen: quick logs dump (most recent):
```
[2026-03-17T03:05:12Z] embed-worker-12 KVCache miss 83% route=embeds req_id=ff3a
[2026-03-17T03:05:15Z] rate-limiter throttle applied route=embeds limit=200/s dropped=12
[2026-03-17T03:06:02Z] downstream 502 embed-processor timeout 10s
```

Tara Li: Throttled canary for embeds at 50% ingress via `rlctl set canary embeds 50%` to keep a window for mitigation while we observe. Also raised a transient suppression on alert `embeds-error-rate` to avoid noisy paging while we validate bypass.

Sam Parker: Dashboard + runbook links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embeds-latency and https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/rate-limiter. Monitoring: watch p95/p99 and queue_length. If error rate drops <1% and p99 returns to baseline, we keep bypass for 30m and then roll to canary off.

Mike Chen: Observing metrics: p99 went 120ms -> 910ms, error rate peaked 4.6% (mostly 502 timeouts). KV cache miss pattern suggests warmup problem on the new limiter path. I'll tail logs for next 30m.

Irene Cho: Owner for rollback if no improvement: Irene. Planned rollback point: rev ab12ab12 (previous config). If no meaningful recovery by +15m, I'll initiate rollback and notify infra-sched.

Tara Li: Taking the next shift. My checklist: 1) verify fallback pool throughput, 2) confirm suppressions cleared if stable, 3) if errors >3% for 10m -> escalate to SEV3. Ping me `@tara.li` in thread if you need immediate handoff.

Sam Parker: Thanks — handing over to Tara. Summary for oncoming: incident = embeds degraded after rate-limiter tweak; mitigation = fallback routing + 50% canary throttle; next steps = monitor 15m, rollback if no improvement, owner = Irene for rollback, Tara for watch/alerts. Will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
